name: bounded-verified-object-ingestion
intent: Convert a declared object set into a reconciled local ingestion artifact with exact membership, validation, quarantine, and replay evidence.
successCondition: Stop when every manifest object is accepted, quarantined, or rejected exactly once and replay verification is clean.
outputs: accepted rejected quarantine and rollback ledger
operations: validate identity shape size and digest
write accepted objects and reconcile a replay ledger
preconditions: destination and rollback boundaries are writable and distinct
positiveTriggers: Ingest a declared object set with exact integrity checks.
Reconcile accepted quarantined and rejected objects into a replayable ledger.
negativeTriggers: Crawl or read files outside the authorized manifest.
Mutate storage before identity integrity and rollback gates pass.
failureModes: quarantine collisions instead of overwriting them
terminationConditions: Stop when every manifest object is accepted, quarantined, or rejected exactly once and replay verification is clean.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-atlas route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
